title: Telemetry by category
description: What FUSION holds, grouped by what it is about: the machines and the telemetry pipeline (system), the cluster's own objects (Kubernetes) and what applications report about themselves (application). The category is decided from the metric's name and from the namespace of a log line or span, the same rule the FUSION API's `category` filter uses, so what is listed here is what that filter returns. Pick an application to narrow the Kubernetes pods and the Application row to its services.

list.name: application
list.label: Application
list.description: Narrows the pod panels of the Kubernetes row and everything in the Application row to the services of one Ikhnos application (a service in one namespace of one cluster; traces are matched by service name only). All applications (the default) leaves everything as it was. The System row, the node and kube-system panels never follow it.

list.name: member
list.label: Members (derived)
list.description: The services of the chosen application, each as service/namespace/cluster. Empty with All applications. Not meant to be changed.

list.name: service
list.label: Service names (derived)

query.query: query_result(label_replace(vector(1) and on() (label_replace(vector(1), "application", ${application:doublequote}, "", "") and on(application) label_replace(vector(1), "application", "__all__", "", "")), "service_name", ".*", "", "") or group by (service_name) (ikhnos_application_info{application=${application:doublequote}, member=~"$member"}))

list.definition: query_result(label_replace(vector(1) and on() (label_replace(vector(1), "application", ${application:doublequote}, "", "") and on(application) label_replace(vector(1), "application", "__all__", "", "")), "service_name", ".*", "", "") or group by (service_name) (ikhnos_application_info{application=${application:doublequote}, member=~"$member"}))
list.description: The service names of the chosen application; with All applications the single value .* (anything). Not meant to be changed.

panels.title: System: the machines and the telemetry pipeline

panels.title: Scrape targets down

panels.title: Host CPU busy

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - sum by (continuum_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) (rate(system_cpu_time_seconds_total{state="idle", continuum_cluster_id=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (continuum_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) (rate(system_cpu_time_seconds_total{continuum_cluster_id=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Host memory by state

panels.title: Scrape duration

panels.title: Spans per second, by service

targets.query: { resource.k8s.namespace.name != "kube-system" && resource.k8s.namespace.name != "kube-public" && resource.k8s.namespace.name != "kube-node-lease" && resource.service.name =~ "${service:pipe}" } | rate() by (resource.service.name)
